HINDI 1: This is an introductory course in Hindi that presents the Devanagari script, elementary grammar and sentence structure.
HINDI 2: This intermediate level course seeks to impart functional literacy in oral and written expression in Hindi to students.
HINDI 3: This is an intermediate level course in Hindi that seeks to improve student's skills in oral and written expression.
HINDI 110: Hindi 110 teaches basic intermediate to advanced functional proficiency (ACTFL Standards) in reading, writing, and speaking Hindi.
